name: new-ui-mock
title_zh: 新界面先画在原型画布上，用现成设计令牌而非拍脑袋配色
tagline_zh: 改版/加功能时，不用再开 Figma 或猜色值。直接在画布上生成自包含 HTML 稿，自动继承令牌。
tagline_en: Skip Figma and guesswork—mock new screens right on the canvas, reusing design tokens, batch-generating variants.
desc_en: Design a new screen, flow or component as a self-contained HTML artboard on the prototype canvas, built from the board's existing design tokens rather than invented values. Covers picking or extending the token block, generating a row of screens from one script, iterating against annotated screenshots, and verifying by rendering. Use when asked to mock up a new screen or feature, design variants/p
why_zh: 它把设计稿变成代码画布上的活物：令牌从现有块里挑或扩展，脚本一次生成一排屏，截图反馈直接驱动下一轮。
why_en: Turns mockups into living code on the canvas: tokens are picked or extended from existing blocks, one script spawns a row of.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML 画布上的原型，不接 Figma 或独立 HTML 文件；令牌必须来自当前画布已有块。
limit_en: Only works on the prototype canvas (not Figma or standalone HTML); tokens must come from existing blocks on that board, else it stops to ask. Output.
title_en: Mock new screens on the prototype canvas with existing.
